description: For distinct atoms \(a\) and \(b\), replacing \(a\) by \(b\) and then replacing \(b\) by \(a\) sends \(a\to b\) to \(a\to a\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.subst_sequential_imp.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (a b : α)
  (hab : a ≠ b) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.subst
      (fun c =>
        if c = b then Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom a
        else Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom c)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.subst
        (fun c =>
          if c = a then Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom b
          else Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom c)
        ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom a).impl
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom b))) =
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom a).impl
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom a)
